process.title:
From idea
to shipped
process.intro: A repeatable, honest process built from years of client work. No surprises, no theatre. Just the steps that get a product from a first conversation to something real in users' hands.

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.desc: Before a single pixel, we map the actual problem: who it is for, what success looks like, and what already exists. You leave with a lean brief everyone agrees on.
points: Lean written brief, not a 60-page deck

design.title: Design
design.desc: Tokens, components and motion are defined early, then pressure-tested in interactive prototypes, with short feedback loops so nothing surprises you later.

build.title: Build
build.desc: Production-grade frontend with a focus on accessibility, performance, and code your team can extend long after handover.

ship.title: Ship
ship.desc: Releasing is a feature, not an afterthought. QA, monitoring and rollout plans are ready before launch day.

iterate.title: Iterate
iterate.desc: The first release is data, not an ending. We review what users actually do and keep improving, or hand over cleanly.
